headline: Datang’s Zhongwei compute campus solar phase is reported operational; wind supply remains unverified
summary: A report hosted by the National Energy Administration’s Northwest Office says China Datang’s 500-MW photovoltaic plant for the Zhongwei Cloud Base entered operation on 2026-05-02. It describes a dedicated-line physical-supply arrangement for incremental data-center load and bilateral power-market transactions for existing load. The article says the separate 1.5-GW wind phase was planned for full grid connection in September 2026 and that 2.29 TWh per year could meet campus demand after the first phase is fully operational. These are attributed project reports; this review did not establish post-September wind commissioning, metered generation, campus delivery or realized cost and reliability effects.
